name: Payment - Fixed Fee
text: In consideration of the Services, the Client shall pay the Service Provider a fixed fee as set out in this Agreement, exclusive of applicable Goods and Services Tax (GST), which shall be charged additionally at the prevailing rate. The fixed fee shall be payable against a valid tax invoice within thirty (30) days of receipt. The Client shall deduct tax at source (TDS) where applicable under the Income-tax Act, 1961, and shall furnish the corresponding TDS certificate. No additional amounts shall be payable unless agreed in writing.

legal_basis.act: Central Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017
legal_basis.note: Levy of GST on supply of services
